sourceVersion: Alpha Husky Bible v1.1 EN FINAL

publicPolicy.purpose: A player-facing view of current Alpha Husky product truth.
publicPolicy.statusRule: Code, build and device/runtime evidence are not treated as the same thing.
publicPolicy.redactionRule: Security-sensitive implementation details, tester data, private operational identifiers and exploit-sensitive internals are excluded.
publicPolicy.historyRule: Historical evidence is preserved as history and is not presented as current LIVE truth.

statusLegend.label: Verified
statusLegend.description: Supported by an appropriate audit, verifier or runtime test.

statusLegend.label: In testing
statusLegend.description: Implemented or partly verified, with a current runtime/device gate still open.

statusLegend.label: Planned
statusLegend.description: Approved direction, not presented as implemented.

statusLegend.label: Historical
statusLegend.description: Real earlier state retained for the record, not current product truth.

playNow.title: Missions & FIRST SIGNAL
playNow.detail: The early mission flow has verified backend/FTUE layers. A fresh standalone Android entry regression remains openly tracked.

playNow.title: Tactical Ops
playNow.detail: Broken Signal, Field Ops, the Living War Table and Pack Mastery form the verified/implemented tactical core; the newest presentation layer keeps its own device gate.

playNow.title: Moon Lab
playNow.detail: The 30-floor progression core is preserved, with later visual polish and Active Pursuit work recorded separately by evidence level.

playNow.title: Builds, stats & gear
playNow.detail: Backend-authoritative stats and equipment remain the build foundation, with the Android stat-allocation repair recorded as verified.

playNow.title: Blood Moon
playNow.detail: The core event plus standalone Direct Blood Moon / Tower routing has real-device evidence; the wider Full Moon economy remains open.

playNow.title: Identity & community
playNow.detail: Field Record identity work and Community Bot V1.2 have verified evidence; community scale is still presented honestly as early.

flow: Leave a record in the living world

books.title: Project foundation & player entry
books.summary: How Alpha defines truth, brings a player into the world and decides when the first session is actually ready.

books.title: Progression, combat & economy
books.summary: The systems that make a run matter: progression, missions, tactical combat, pets, builds, gear and the soft economy.

books.title: World, factions & events
books.summary: The playable world layer: map, lore, factions, living-world signals and Blood Moon.

books.title: Platform, community & operations
books.summary: How the same Alpha player moves across clients, how identity/community works and how the project verifies what it ships.

systems.title: Project Canon & Source of Truth
systems.statusDetail: Current canon — Telegram/WebApp and standalone Android share one server-authoritative player truth.
systems.summary: The rulebook behind every public claim: backend state wins, newer verified evidence can supersede older descriptions, and build success is not the same as a device pass.
systems.publicLimit: Internal auth, build-security and operational details are deliberately not exposed here.

systems.title: FTUE, Onboarding & Campaign Readiness
systems.statusDetail: Core FTUE implemented/verified; fresh standalone Android entry blocker remains open.
systems.summary: Alpha's guided opening connects callsign, oath/faction context, FIRST SIGNAL, the first reward/equip moment and the bridge into the wider world.
systems.publicLimit: A current standalone fresh-player entry regression is shown as an open gate rather than hidden.

systems.title: Progression Spine & MoonLab
systems.statusDetail: Moon Lab core preserved; later polish / Active Pursuit layers keep separate device evidence.
systems.summary: The long-form progression spine that gives the player a next goal, with Moon Lab's 30-floor ladder, sector structure, bosses and persistent progress.
systems.publicLimit: Latest presentation work is not silently promoted beyond its recorded device evidence.

systems.title: Alpha Den, War Room & Tactical Briefs
systems.statusDetail: Den boundaries preserved; War Table / Tactical Rank / Pack Mastery stack expanded with verifier evidence and open cumulative device checks.
systems.summary: The personal preparation layer around tactical play: the Den remains separate while the War Table adds rotating Field Ops, rank, pressure and companion mastery.
systems.publicLimit: Prepared Attempt and newer Tactical progression remain separate systems; the page does not invent a unified power economy.

systems.title: Standard Missions & Quest Board
systems.statusDetail: FIRST SIGNAL flow verified in backend/FTUE layers; current fresh standalone board entry remains blocked.
systems.summary: The repeatable mission surface and first-mission contract. FIRST SIGNAL now has a much stronger protected state/reward flow than the original July baseline.
systems.publicLimit: The site does not claim a complete live audit of every standard mission tier, timer or reward table.

systems.title: Elite Missions & Tactical Combat
systems.statusDetail: Tactical core / verifiers passed; newest v3.x presentation still has a separate device recheck.
systems.summary: Alpha's turn-based tactical layer now extends beyond the original Elite slice into Broken Signal, reusable Field Ops, the Living War Table and Pack Mastery.
systems.publicLimit: Repository merges prove implementation, not physical-device acceptance of every latest visual pass.

systems.title: Siege & PvP Duel
systems.statusDetail: July code-closed baseline preserved; current Telegram/APK runtime requires a fresh dedicated smoke.
systems.summary: Siege is the PvP duel / territory-pressure branch associated with Edge of the Chain. Its historical implementation evidence remains real, but current runtime status is deliberately conservative.
systems.publicLimit: A map destination is not treated as proof that the complete current Siege runtime has passed.

systems.title: Teamup & Cooperative Combat
systems.statusDetail: Ten-wave code + verifier baseline preserved; fresh live Telegram / standalone parity smoke remains open.
systems.summary: The cooperative combat branch built around a ten-wave run, contribution tracking, scaling and safe single settlement.
systems.publicLimit: Absence of a newer dedicated checkpoint is not presented as either a regression or a fresh runtime pass.

systems.title: Stats, Buildcraft & Equipment
systems.statusDetail: Tactical stat bridge verified; Android stat allocation fix recorded; Forge artwork regression tracked separately.
systems.summary: Character power remains backend-authoritative across base stats, pets and gear, with a capped bridge into Tactical Ops rather than a second combat-stat system.
systems.publicLimit: Visual Forge asset issues are not misreported as economy/stat failures.

systems.title: Pets, Evolution & Consumable Effects
systems.statusDetail: Pet core preserved; Adoption Center V2 and PET mastery implemented with full device/persistence acceptance still open.
systems.summary: Pets remain part of progression and tactical identity, while Adoption Center V2 provides a more game-like companion discovery and ownership surface.
systems.publicLimit: Gallery → detail → adopt → restart/persistence is still tracked as a full acceptance path.

systems.title: Economy, Currency, Loot & Upgrade
systems.statusDetail: Core soft-economy canon preserved; optional wallet/HOWL ownership read verified; UI regressions kept separate.
systems.summary: Bones, Scrap, Rune Dust, gear upgrades and loot remain part of the game-first economy. HOWL/wallet ownership is optional and does not buy combat dominance.
systems.publicLimit: Wallet ownership proof does not imply spending, staking, swaps, payouts or token-gated progression.

systems.title: World Exploration & RELAY-7
systems.statusDetail: Map V2 is current; real-device spatial flow passed in part; the older scan/unlock system remains historical/disabled.
systems.summary: The current world map is a spatial WORLD → REGION → activity surface built around Citadel, Blackglass Reach, Iron March and Locked Horizons.
systems.publicLimit: The legacy scan/key-fragment exploration design is not presented as the current map loop.

systems.title: World, Lore, NPC & Factions
systems.statusDetail: Living-world and faction runtime expanded with a mix of verified and implemented evidence.
systems.summary: Four factions share one post-collapse world. Newer systems make that world react through real frontline state, faction HQ surfaces, activity records and map response.
systems.publicLimit: Alpha does not fabricate crowds, online counts or player activity to make the world look busier than it is.

systems.title: Blood Moon Tower & Events
systems.statusDetail: Blood Moon core plus standalone Direct Blood Moon / Tower route have device-pass evidence; wider Full Moon economy stays open.
systems.summary: The Blood Moon is a faction PvE event/challenge branch with a current standalone route and a wider lunar-event direction that is kept separate from what has actually been verified.
systems.publicLimit: Full Moon shop pricing, exclusivity and wider economy evolution are not presented as finished.

systems.title: Mobile APK, Companion & Alpha Account
systems.statusDetail: Android is a functioning second client with multiple device passes; the public release gate remains open.
systems.summary: Telegram/WebApp and standalone Android are two access paths to the same Alpha player. Veteran progress can be restored without creating a second game state.
systems.publicLimit: Internal authentication, session security and build-pipeline implementation details are intentionally redacted.

systems.title: Pack Comms, Community & Campaign
systems.statusDetail: Pack Comms core preserved; Community Bot V1.2 verified; Road to 25 recorded at 7/25; acquisition remains early.
systems.summary: Alpha keeps community, in-game communication and public campaigns separate, with a strict rule that marketing cannot outrun verified build truth.
systems.publicLimit: The project does not claim solved retention, large DAU/MAU or scalable acquisition.

systems.title: Badges, Titles, Cosmetics & Visual Assets
systems.statusDetail: Identity core and Field Record verified; newer presentation/asset layers keep their own runtime evidence.
systems.summary: Callsign, titles, badges, frames, skins and Field Record build identity without becoming a hidden source of combat power.
systems.publicLimit: Committed art is not automatically treated as owned, catalog-ready or live in the client.

systems.title: Technical Operations, QoL & Performance
systems.publicTitle: How Alpha verifies what it ships
systems.statusDetail: Operating doctrine updated around canonical sync, separate evidence gates, real-device testing and measured performance.
systems.summary: The project records code/build/device evidence separately, measures performance fixes and treats WebApp, Telegram WebView and standalone Android as distinct runtime surfaces.
systems.publicLimit: Security-sensitive operational details, private identifiers and exploit-relevant internals are intentionally excluded.
